name: Fry's Southwest Grocery Distribution Center Tolleson AZ

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance off S 99th Ave at the SE corner; long private two-lane drive (median planter strip) leads to a checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white guard booth with a dark canopy roof on a yellow-curbed island that splits the inbound/outbound lanes mid-drive (33.43795,-112.2739, z21 satellite); ~1-vehicle footprint, staffed-booth form factor.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Street View shows 4+ trucks queued on the deep entrance drive between 99th Ave and the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance apron with separate inbound/outbound lanes and ample paved width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct large buildings with dock banks on different faces (main DC south face + east building) plus a central admin spine; consistent with separate ship/receive operations. Medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main DC building, a second large DC building to the east, and an SE office/utility (fuel/tank) cluster.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock banks across the main building south wall and the east building exceed 50 doors; ~120 is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of parked trailers across the NW angled lot and central rows; far exceeds the 50+ band. Counts are honest overhead estimates.
fieldNotes.railServed: A multi-track rail corridor runs along the NW property edge as a buffer, but no spur enters the fenced property; classified not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Tolleson industrial area on the Phoenix metro fringe; open farm fields border the entrance drive and the south/west sides. Per rubric tie-break, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Metro-fringe with dense industrial neighbors and a major arterial (99th Ave); cellular coverage likely fine, so false.

citations.claim: Kroger corporate logistics page lists Frys DC at 500 South 99th Avenue, Tolleson AZ 85353; appointment email routes to Windigo US (3PL), indicating Kroger-owned Frys DC run by a 3PL.
Kroger ended its Ruan transportation contract (ops stopping Aug 27 2025) and signed an LOI for CSI Retail Services to run the Tolleson DC; facility keeps stocking every Frys store in Arizona.

verification.rationale: Kroger/Frys still operate the Tolleson DC (per Kroger logistics page) but via 3PL operators; operating, not closed.
